title: Gold Rewards Card: Apply for a Premium Credit Card
summary: This document covers applying for the Gold Rewards Card, including eligibility (minimum credit score $720 and required Rho‑Bank+ subscription), fees and rates (annual fee $0.00, APR 17.99%, late payment fee $32.50, foreign transaction fee 0%), rewards (2.5% cash back, $15 minimum to redeem), and purchase protection ($105 days, up to $7,500 per claim). It also states typical credit limits ($17,500–$112,500) and application steps in the Rho‑Bank dashboard plus virtual card management availability after approval.
